name: BottomNavigation
description: Mobile bottom tab bar navigation for switching between top-level views. Displays a fixed row of icons with labels at the bottom of the viewport, following mobile navigation conventions.

notes: Renders as a <nav> element with aria-label for landmark identification.
Active tab is marked with aria-current='page'.
All tabs are keyboard accessible with visible focus indicators.
Icon-only tabs must include a visible label for accessibility.

items.description: Array of navigation items to render as bottom tabs.

activeKey.description: The key of the currently active tab.

onChange.description: Callback fired when a tab is selected.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use BottomNavigation for primary mobile navigation between top-level views.
Limit to 3-5 items for optimal usability.
Always provide both icon and label for each item.
dont: Do not use BottomNavigation on desktop layouts.
Do not use more than 5 navigation items.
Do not use BottomNavigation for secondary or nested navigation.
